description: Java Spring Boot REST controller for managing calendar events, providing CRUD operations and range search.

classes.name: EventController
classes.description: REST controller for Event resources, handling CRUD operations and range search endpoints.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event using data from the request body.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a list of all events.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its unique ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an event by its ID.

methods.name: findByRange
methods.description: Finds and returns events overlapping the specified time range.
